Memilih tindakan yang menjaga keselamatan, mutu, dan batas kewenangan.
Menggunakan ungkapan Jepang sederhana yang terkait dengan pekerjaan.
lessons.response: Do not change the status to ready. Report the light to a technician or housekeeping and wait for inspection confirmation.
lessons.scenario: The room looks clean, but the bathroom light is flickering and the system says it is awaiting inspection.

sections.body: A room may be occupied, need cleaning, be under cleaning, await inspection, or be ready. Use the property's terms. Follow the inspection checklist, and only perform work within your authority. Record damage so the room is not offered before it is declared ready.
sections.title: Work Concepts and Standards

sections.body: Match the room number and system status, then follow the inspection sequence. If you find a leak, damaged wiring, broken glass, or a left-behind item, do not mark the room ready. Notify housekeeping or a technician and update the system after the inspection is complete.
sections.title: Applying the Procedures at Work

steps: Cocokkan kamar dengan daftar dan status sistem
Periksa kebersihan serta fasilitas sesuai tugas
Tandai dan laporkan kerusakan atau barang tertinggal
Perbarui status setelah pemeriksaan selesai
lessons.title: Room Status and Damage Reporting

lessons.caution: Do not touch suspicious items or investigate a hazard before it is safe.

checks.explanation: Official storage keeps the item secure and helps its owner verify it.
options: Record it and hand it over to official storage without opening it
Open it to look for a name
Take it home
Announce the bag’s contents in the lobby
checks.prompt: What should you do with a lost item?

checks.explanation: Authorized staff handle smoke and unidentified objects, with safety as the priority.
options: Go in and retrieve the bag
Do not enter or touch anything; move people away and activate reporting
Open the bag
Leave without reporting it
checks.prompt: There is smoke coming from a service room and an unidentified bag near the door. What should you do?

checks.explanation: Recommended order: Assess the situation and ensure safety → Activate the appropriate reporting or response process → Keep found items safe without opening or using them → Record the location and hand them to authorized staff.
options: Activate the appropriate reporting or response process
Assess the situation and ensure safety
Keep the found item safe without opening or using it
Record its location and hand it to authorized staff
checks.prompt: In the “Lost Items and Emergencies” workflow, what is the next step after the first step?

dialogue.japanese: 煙が見えます。
dialogue.meaning: I see smoke.
dialogue.reading: けむりがみえます。

dialogue.japanese: 安全な場所へ案内します。
dialogue.meaning: I will guide people to a safe place.
dialogue.reading: あんぜんなばしょへあんないします。

objectives: Mengamankan barang temuan atau bahaya serta segera memakai jalur laporan properti.
Memilih tindakan yang menjaga keselamatan, mutu, dan batas kewenangan.
Menggunakan ungkapan Jepang sederhana yang terkait dengan pekerjaan.
lessons.response: Do not enter or move the bag. Keep people away, activate the reporting procedure, and tell staff where the smoke is coming from.
lessons.scenario: Smoke is coming from a service room, and an unknown bag is near the door.

sections.body: Record the location, time, and description of a lost item, then store it through the official process; do not open or use it. Emergencies may include fires, earthquakes, leaks, accidents, or an ill guest. Follow the evacuation plan, report the situation, and do not obstruct emergency responders.
sections.title: Work Concepts and Standards

sections.body: If you see smoke, smell gas, find a major water leak, or see someone needing help, put safety first and activate the alarm or call procedure. Do not touch suspicious items. Direct people to safety only within the limits of your training.
sections.title: Applying the Procedures at Work

steps: Amati kondisi dan pastikan keselamatan
Aktifkan pelaporan atau bantuan sesuai kejadian
Jaga barang temuan tanpa membuka atau menggunakannya
Catat lokasi dan serahkan kepada petugas berwenang
lessons.title: Lost Property and Emergencies

lessons.caution: Do not promise an unapproved price, facility, or room status.

checks.explanation: Prices and offer periods can change, so use the latest approved information.
options: Official materials, conditions, dates, and validity period
Any old poster
A price you remember
Prices at other hotels
checks.prompt: What should you check before explaining a promotional price?

checks.explanation: Verify outdated information before promising a price.
options: Continue to promise the price shown on the poster
Hold off on making a promise, confirm with the person in charge, then explain the latest information
Remove the poster yourself
Ask the guest to choose the price
checks.prompt: An old poster shows a promotion, but the system says it has ended. What should you do?

checks.explanation: Recommended order: Check the official materials and their validity period → Explain the approved offer → Record requests and pending work → Hand over directly and confirm the recipient understands.
options: Explain the approved offer
Check the official materials and their validity period
Record requests and pending work
Hand it over directly and confirm the recipient understands
checks.prompt: In the “Promotion Information and Shift Handover” workflow, what is the next step after the first step?

dialogue.japanese: このプランは今も有効ですか。
dialogue.meaning: Is this package still valid?
dialogue.reading: このぷらんはいまもゆうこうですか。

dialogue.japanese: 新しい情報を確認します。
dialogue.meaning: I will check the latest information.
dialogue.reading: あたらしいじょうほうをかくにんします。

objectives: Menyampaikan penawaran yang disahkan dan menyerahkan pekerjaan terbuka dengan waktu serta status yang jelas.
Memilih tindakan yang menjaga keselamatan, mutu, dan batas kewenangan.
Menggunakan ungkapan Jepang sederhana yang terkait dengan pekerjaan.
lessons.response: Do not promise the price shown on the old poster. Check with the person in charge and explain that the price is being confirmed.
lessons.scenario: A guest asks about a promotion price on an old poster, but the system shows that the offer period has ended.

sections.body: Planning and communications may cover facilities, events, packages, or nearby services. Use approved materials because dates, prices, and terms change. At shift change, pass on complaints, room status, requests, times, contacts, and next steps. Do not rely on memory or outdated status information.
sections.title: Work Concepts and Standards

sections.body: Before answering questions about a promotion, check the official materials or ask the person in charge. For a handover, record the relevant room or order, facts, actions, status, and follow-up. Hand it over directly and ask the recipient to repeat important information.
sections.title: Applying the Procedures at Work

steps: Periksa materi resmi dan masa berlakunya
Jelaskan penawaran yang telah disahkan
Catat permintaan dan pekerjaan terbuka
Serahkan langsung dan pastikan penerima memahami
